Basic Duty Exemption on Textiles (Chapter 50 to 63) - Valid till 1st May 2022 - To be Rescinded by 05/01.02.2022

[55/29.12.2021 - HS2022 Changes w.e.f. 1 Jan 2022 incorporated]

Specific Duty Floor of Rs. 100 per kg Imposed on Pile Fabrics in 6001 92 00 – Previous Description was 20% - 01/05.01.2018 (DINDEX Code 8459)

[38/30.12.2019 – HS Code Amended]

[53/2018-Customs dated 16 July 2018 - Boost for Textile Sector with Import Duty on Over 50 Products Doubled - New Rates are within WTO Bound Rates which are generally 40% for Consumable Goods

The import duty on apparels such as coat and pants, jackets, and ladies garments, which earlier was 10 per cent, will now be 20 per cent, according to the notificatiow3fn issued by Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Custom. Similar rates will be applicable to clothes made from jute or paper yarn, different varieties of carpets, laminated fibre and sheets made from fibres, and so on.

On some items, the rates will be 20 per cent or ₹38 per sq metre whichever is higher. According to the board, there have been 45 changes, including in specific and ad valorem rates.]

[15/01.02.2021 – SNos. 1,2 and 5 amended;  Duty raised to 15% from 10% to SNo.2.]
